versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file from the project.
- Updated default model in SKILL.md from "u1-insuremed" to "u2-med".
- No other user-facing functionality changes.

- Initial release of the skill for outpatient EMR quality control: checks if the chief complaint and diagnosis site are inconsistent.
- Supports UTF-8 plain text input with field tags (e.g., 主诉, 现病史, 初步诊断) and multi-format files (pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, csv, txt, json).
- Leverages HiVoice MaaS medical LLM via OpenAI-compatible API; outputs “无缺陷” (No Defect) or “有缺陷” (Defect) plus reason.
- Strictly enforces data privacy and security by requiring de-identified input, not storing data locally, and not requiring personal identifiers.
- No third-party dependencies required for basic usage; optional packages for multi-format input.
- Includes clear CLI usage instructions and parameters for both text and multi-format EMR input.
